definitions.gloss: kinpira; stir-fried and simmered root vegetables
definitions.explanation: a Japanese dish of julienned root vegetables (typically burdock and carrot) stir-fried and simmered in soy sauce, sugar, and mirin

⟦お{弁当|べんとう}→お弁当：02864_obentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧きんぴら⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Named after {金平|きんぴら} (Kintaro's son in folklore), who was known for his strength. The spiciness from chili pepper was associated with strength.

MAIN VARIETIES:
- きんぴらごぼう - burdock and carrot kinpira (most common)
- きんぴられんこん - lotus root kinpira
- きんぴらにんじん - carrot kinpira

INGREDIENTS:
- ⟦{牛蒡|ごぼう}→牛蒡：13484_gobou⟧ - burdock root
- ⟦{人参|にんじん}→人参：05185_ninjin⟧ - carrot
- ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧ - soy sauce
- ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧ - sugar
- ⟦{味醂|みりん}→味醂：04918_mirin⟧ - mirin
- ⟦{唐辛子|とうがらし}→唐辛子：11871_tougarashi⟧ - red pepper (optional)
- ⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧ - sesame seeds (topping)

CULTURAL NOTE:
A classic home-cooking (⟦{家庭料理|かていりょうり}→家庭料理：17474_kateiryouri⟧) dish, commonly found in bento boxes and as a side dish (⟦{副菜|ふくさい}→副菜：04993_fukusai⟧).
